name: Create a milestone
description: Create a milestone Creates a milestone. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones
Creates a milestone.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Delete a milestone
description: Delete a milestone Deletes a milestone using the given milestone number. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{milestone_number}

name: Get a milestone
description: Get a milestone Gets a milestone using the given milestone number. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{milestone_number}

name: List labels for issues in a milestone
description: List labels for issues in a milestone Lists labels for issues in a milestone. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{milestone_number}/labels
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{milestone_number}/labels
Lists labels for issues in a milestone.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; milestone_number (path) — The number that identifies the milestone.
Optional: per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. name: List milestones
description: List milestones Lists milestones for a repository. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones
Lists milestones for a repository.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: state (query) — The state of the milestone. Either `open`, `closed`, or `all`.; sort (query) — What to sort results by. Either `due_on` or `completeness`.; direction (query) — The direction of the sort. Either `asc` or `desc`.; per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
